!Version ArubaOS-CX FL.10.09.0010
!Model: 6300M-48G-4SFP56
!export-password: default
hostname sw-aruba-01
user admin group administrators password ciphertext AQBapXXXXX
!
ntp server pool.ntp.org
ntp enable
!
vlan 1
vlan 10
    name USERS
vlan 20
    name SERVERS
vlan 100
    name GUEST
!
access-list ip WEB-IN
    10 permit tcp any 10.0.20.0/24 eq 443
    20 permit tcp any 10.0.20.0/24 eq 80 log
    30 deny any any any
!
access-list ip GUEST-IN
    10 permit any any any
!
interface lag 1
    no shutdown
    description to-core-01
    no routing
    vlan trunk native 1
    vlan trunk allowed 10,20
    lacp mode active
!
interface 1/1/1
    no shutdown
    description to-core-01-a
    lag 1
!
interface 1/1/2
    no shutdown
    description to-core-01-b
    lag 1
!
interface 1/1/10
    no shutdown
    description server-01
    no routing
    vlan access 20
!
interface 1/1/11
    description yobi-port
    no routing
    vlan access 20
!
interface 1/1/24
    no shutdown
    description guest-ap
    no routing
    vlan access 100
    apply access-list ip GUEST-IN in
!
interface vlan 10
    ip address 10.0.10.1/24
    ip ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
    ip ospf hello-interval 10
    ip ospf dead-interval 40
!
interface vlan 20
    ip address 10.0.20.1/24
    ip ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
    apply access-list ip WEB-IN in
!
interface vlan 100
    vrf attach GUEST
    ip address 10.0.100.1/24
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.10.254
ip route 10.9.0.0/16 10.0.20.254 200
!
router ospf 1
    router-id 10.0.10.1
    area 0.0.0.0
!
router bgp 65001
    bgp router-id 10.0.10.1
    neighbor 10.0.10.2 remote-as 65002
!
vsx
    system-mac 02:01:00:00:01:00
    inter-switch-link lag 1
    role primary
!
